data.title: Wire settings.py DATABASES to POSTGRES_* env vars

data.body:
Self-review (same caveat as HDT-2: operator instruction in this session forbids spawning sub-agents unless the user asks, so the review gate's independence requirement is unmet).

Acceptance criteria:
1. PASS - manage.py check: 'System check identified no issues (0 silenced)'.
2. PASS - manage.py migrate applied all 18 migrations, no errors.
3. PASS - psql in the db container: 18 rows in django_migrations, 10 tables in the hexmodal database. Confirms a real Postgres connection rather than a silent sqlite fallback.
4. PASS - GET / returns 200, GET /admin/ returns 302. 'unapplied migration' warning gone from fresh logs.
5. PASS - app/requirements.txt untouched; no new dependency (os.environ.get only).

Cleanup: removed stale zero-byte app/db.sqlite3 left by the previous sqlite config. No data loss (file was empty).

Scope note: commit b78b6ae also committed the previously-untracked app/ tree and recorded the root Dockerfile/requirements.txt deletions. That is HDT-2 leftover, not HDT-3 work - 9bd1b19 committed app/Dockerfile while the files it COPYs stayed untracked, so a fresh clone could not build. Folded in to leave the tree coherent; called out in the commit body.

Still hardcoded in settings.py, out of scope for this task, each needs its own: SECRET_KEY (compose injects DJANGO_SECRET_KEY), DEBUG (DJANGO_DEBUG), ALLOWED_HOSTS = [] (DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS). ALLOWED_HOSTS is empty only because DEBUG=True masks it - it will 400 the moment DEBUG is off.
